title: Effect of proton pump inhibitors on the structural integrity of endoscopic sleeve gastroplasty: a single-centre open-label, randomized, controlled pilot clinical trial
official: Effect of proton pump inhibitors on the structural integrity of endoscopic sleeve gastroplasty: a single-centre open-label, randomized, controlled pilot clinical trial
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the effect of PPI’s on the structural integrity of the ESG
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age 20 to 65 years
2. BMI between 30 to 45 kg/m2
3. Willingness to participate in the study and ability to comply and understand the study protocol
Exclusion criteria:
1. Active gastric gastro-duodenal during the last 6 months
2. Continuous glucocorticoid or anti-inflammatory treatment
3. Uncontrolled thyroid disease
4. Pregnancy, breastfeeding
5. Psychiatric or cooperative problems or low compliance that is a contraindication from participating in the study
6. Hiatal hernia ≥ 5 cm
7. Known allergy or hypersensitivity to the active substance or any of the other excipients
8. Liver cirrhosis of any Child-Phugh stage or MELD> 15
9. Chronic Severe Renal Insufficiency (eGFR < 30 ml/min/1.73 m2 based on CKD-EPI equation)
10. Currently participating in other study, or previously participated in an experimental drugs trial within 30 days before or 5 half-life of the drug administered
11. Any health issue that might put the patient at risk if the treatment is performed, judged by the investigator.
12. Helicobacter pylori infection
13. Organic or motility disorder of the stomach and / or esophagus
14. Anticoagulant treatment
15. Previous bariatric surgery or any other type of surgery of the esophagus, stomach and duodenum
16. Ongoing or active malignancy during the last 5 years
17. Myocardial infarction during the past 6 months or/and heart failure class III or IV according to the New York Heart association’s classification
18. Drug or alcohol abuse
19. Bulimic or binge eating pattern
